name: direction_a_main_v2
question: How do arrival rounding, omitted source history and specular reflections alter azimuth error in a verified three-microphone simulation, and what persists under averaging?

attribution.states: each room: centered at nominal 0.15 s; offset at nominal 0.6 s
attribution.variants: F/Q fractional/rounded x S/O steady/onset x D/R direct/reflected
attribution.reuse: F_S_R from core, same exact input identity

signal.source: FFT-bandlimited Gaussian source, 300–3400 Hz, RMS normalized
signal.noise: independent Gaussian microphone noise through same acquisition filter; scaled to direct-only band power
signal.snr_reference: steady direct component, common across eight paired variants

analysis.failure_threshold_status: descriptive engineering threshold; not calibrated perceptual threshold
analysis.uncertainty: 2000 stratified whole-record bootstrap draws within each fixed scene; paired variants resampled together
analysis.room_inference: three fixed geometries, no population-of-rooms confidence statement
analysis.attribution: signed-error and squared-error paired contrasts and interactions; do not subtract RMSE
analysis.averaging: circular mean; compare independent held-out records with stationary covariance prediction only for concentrated training errors; retain all scenes empirically
analysis.small_error_prediction_rule: training circular resultant >=0.95 and training mean angle error <=15 deg in absolute value
analysis.covariance: pooled record-centered autocovariance up to lag32, Bartlett-tapered with positive-part variance safeguard; compare IID approximation; predictions reported as models not confidence intervals

variations.non_equilateral: first microphone y scaled by 0.65 then recentered

sensitivity.method_baseline: SRP-PHAT, same preprocessing/band/regularization, 0.25 degree search and quadratic refinement, checked against 0.05 degree search
sensitivity.numerical_audit: P64/K84/GCC16 on same fixed baseline subset; plus joint K76/T1.2/P32 vs K96/T1.5/P32 on six high-setting controls

amendment.reason: Post-campaign joint duration/image refinement exceeded 0.05 degree target in 10 of 960 frames (maximum 0.16551 degrees). Initial run preserved. Longer response, complete radial support and finer fractional grid verified before revised campaign.
amendment.changes_to_scientific_matrix: None: geometry, SNR, counts, contrasts, concentration rule and uncertainty remain fixed.
amendment.new_inputs: New v2 random namespaces and enough source history for 1.2-second responses.
